tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background: paper cream in light, warm charcoal in dark. Never pure white or black.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs and the composer, above bg.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table headers, code blocks, on bg.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hovered rows and a selected item's fill, on surface-1 or bg.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed state, and the fill of an inactive toggle or track.

tokens.name: fg-1
tokens.usage: Body text, titles and icons at rest, on bg, bg-elevated and every surface.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, inactive tabs, icons beside labels. On bg and surface-1.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Metadata at 11-12px (times, counts, ids, paths in lists), on bg. The faintest text allowed; on surface-1 it reaches only 4.3:1 in light, so use fg-2 there.

tokens.name: fg-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill, such as a primary button. Never cream on amber.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The 1px hairline around cards, inputs, panels and between rows.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: A selected or focused container's border, and dividers that must read at a glance.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Faint separators inside a card, such as between list items.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber, used sparingly: the primary action, the focus ring, the current item's marker, the one series a chart is about.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: An accent fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: The fill behind a selected row or a text selection, over its surface.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text, such as a link or a count that needs attention, on bg and surface-1.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done, merged, passing: a status dot or text, always with a word or icon. On bg and surface-1.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Needs attention, waiting on the person: a status dot or a badge, always with a word in fg-1 beside it. As text on bg it reaches only 4.4:1 in light, so don't set words in it there.

tokens.name: serious
tokens.usage: Serious, between warn and danger: a status dot or badge, always with a word or icon. Never a chart series.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, conflicting, destructive actions: a status dot, text, or a destructive button's text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Running, syncing, neutral notices: a status dot or text.

tokens.name: ok-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind an ok badge or an added diff line.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind a warn badge or notice.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind a danger badge or a removed diff line.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind an info badge or notice.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Dims the page under a modal. No blur.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First categorical series (teal). The six pass `silt design palette` in this order on bg in both themes, and the first three pass it for all pairs in light; in dark they warn at 6.8 for deuteranopia, so a scatter plot or map gives its points direct labels or shapes too.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second categorical series (rust).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third categorical series (plum).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth categorical series (olive).

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth categorical series (slate).

tokens.name: chart-6
tokens.usage: Sixth categorical series (amber). Beyond six, fold into Other or use small multiples.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: Series in the background when one is emphasised in accent, and the Other bucket.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Gridlines and axis lines, on bg.

tokens.name: chart-seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential step 1 of 7 (slate), for magnitude: more is darker in light and lighter in dark.

tokens.name: chart-seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential step 2 of 7 (slate), for magnitude: more is darker in light and lighter in dark.

tokens.name: chart-seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential step 3 of 7 (slate), for magnitude: more is darker in light and lighter in dark.

tokens.name: chart-seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential step 4 of 7 (slate), for magnitude: more is darker in light and lighter in dark.

tokens.name: chart-seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential step 5 of 7 (slate), for magnitude: more is darker in light and lighter in dark.

tokens.name: chart-seq-6
tokens.usage: Sequential step 6 of 7 (slate), for magnitude: more is darker in light and lighter in dark.

tokens.name: chart-seq-7
tokens.usage: Sequential step 7 of 7 (slate), for magnitude: more is darker in light and lighter in dark.

tokens.name: chart-div-neg-3
tokens.usage: Diverging, below the midpoint (rust), step 3 of 3 from it.

tokens.name: chart-div-neg-2
tokens.usage: Diverging, below the midpoint (rust), step 2 of 3 from it.

tokens.name: chart-div-neg-1
tokens.usage: Diverging, below the midpoint (rust), step 1 of 3 from it.

tokens.name: chart-div-mid
tokens.usage: A diverging scale's neutral midpoint: reads as nothing, never a hue.

tokens.name: chart-div-pos-1
tokens.usage: Diverging, above the midpoint (slate), step 1 of 3 from it.

tokens.name: chart-div-pos-2
tokens.usage: Diverging, above the midpoint (slate), step 2 of 3 from it.

tokens.name: chart-div-pos-3
tokens.usage: Diverging, above the midpoint (slate), step 3 of 3 from it.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Times, counts and metadata rows, in fg-3, joined with middle dots.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Secondary lines, table cells in dense tables, badges.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: The product's base size: rows, buttons, labels, menus.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Display headings on documents and marketing, up to 64px. No serif.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code, diffs, terminal output, and inline names a developer would type: branches, paths, ids, commands.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon and its label; inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between items in a row; a compact row's inner padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: A card's inner padding; between rows of a form.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: A panel's padding; the page gutter at phone width.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections of a page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Around a document's major parts.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, chips, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the largest panels. Nothing is rounder, except avatars and status dots.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and status dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: A card that is interactive and raised. Resting cards have none.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and a dragged item.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: Almost every transition: fast in, slow settle.

tokens.name: duration-micro
tokens.usage: Hover, press and small state changes.

tokens.name: duration-panel
tokens.usage: Panels and sheets opening.
